sentences.text:
Mahadeb Bag & Ors vs Unknown on 18 September, 2023
18.09.2023 C.R.M. (A) 3709 of 2023
 Ml. 102
Court No. 29
 Nkb

In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Joypur Police
 Station Case No. 197 of 2023 dated 05.08.2023 under Sections
 498A/328/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code and 3 & 4 of the
D.P. Act (corresponding G.R. Case No.1851/2023).

And 
 In the matter of: Mahadeb Bag & Ors.
 ....petitioners.

1.
Heard learned Advocate for the petitioners and the learned Advocate for the State.
2. The present petitioners are the parents-in-law and the other family members of the in-laws of the victim.
On perusal of the statement of the victim as recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., it reveals that allegation of physical torture upon her is basically against her husband who is not before us.
Admittedly, there are some allegations against the present petitioners but those are at the fringe.

3. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation, the fact that there is always hope of compromise in matrimonial disputes and such compromise is always in the interest of the family and society and substantial progress in investigation, it is directed that the petitioners shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer in the event of their arrest in the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
4. The petitioners are directed to appear before the I.O. within 21 days from today along with a server copy or certified copy of this order.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.

The application being CRM (A) 3709 of 2023 is disposed of.
7. The I.O. is hereby directed to act upon the server copy of this order, if required.

(Chitta Ranjan Dash, J.) (Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
